subject: Next steps: Private VPC architecture review / deep-dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeindustrial.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmeindustrial.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Private VPC architecture review / deep-dive

Hi Alex / Samantha 

Thanks again for the time today 	really useful conversation. Quick recap from our discovery: 
- Goal: move inference workloads on-prem / into a customer VPC with strict network controls and KMS-managed keys
- Primary constraints: data residency, audit logs (SOC2), egress restrictions, and predictable latency for inference at 99th percentile
- Expected scale: initial pilot ~50 req/s, steady-state 300-500 req/s over next 12 months

Next recommended step: schedule a technical architecture review (Private/VPC deep-dive) with our Solutions Engineering team so we can go over: network/topology options, IP/firewall requirements, KMS integration, deployment options (VPC connector vs on-prem appliance), and a short checklist of pre-reqs. 

Proposed times next week (all PDT):
- Tue 9 Jun, 9:00-10:00am
- Wed 10 Jun, 1:00-2:00pm
- Thu 11 Jun, 11:00am-12:00pm

Please let me know which time works best and who from your side should join (network engineer, security lead, infra). We'll include Dev Patel (SE) and Lauren Bishop (Solutions Manager) on our side. I attached a short "Redwood Private" overview and a pre-meeting questionnaire to help us prepare.

Attachments: redwood-private-overview.pdf, pre-meeting-questions.docx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeindustrial.com>

Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0700

Hi Marissa 

Thanks for the recap 	the notes are accurate. We're definitely interested in a technical deep-dive. Our primary ask is to understand the network and security requirements up front so we can engage our infosec and networking teams.

Available windows on our side (PDT):
- Tue 9 Jun, 9:00-10:00am - best
- Wed 10 Jun, 2:00-3:00pm - ok

Please include our infra lead Samantha (cc) and our security contact Michael Thompson (michael.thompson@acmeindustrial.com). Can you also share a short list of required pre-reqs and an IP/firewall range we should temporarily allow for the session?

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Director of Cloud Engineering | Acme Industrial
alex.johnson@acmeindustrial.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeindustrial.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmeindustrial.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Private VPC architecture review / deep-dive

Hi Alex 

Great 	we'll lock in Tue 9 Jun, 9:00-10:00am PDT. I'll send a calendar invite shortly (or you can pick via my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/marissa-private-vpc).

Pre-reqs for the call (short):
- Attendees: infra/network engineer + security lead (for any KMS/privacy questions)
- If possible, have a high-level network diagram and list of allowed egress/ingress rules
- Any compliance docs you need to review in advance (we can share SOC2 summary and data flow diagrams)

For the architecture review we plan to cover:
1) High-level deployment options (VPC connector, private control plane, on-prem package)
2) Network topology & IP/firewall requirements
3) KMS/HSM integration and key management flows
4) Audit logs / retention and SOC2 controls
5) Next steps / minimal pilot checklist

Attachments: network-diagram-template.pdf (quick blank template you can fill to speed the session)

Marissa (I'll follow up with an invite once I confirm with Dev and Lauren)

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Next steps: Private VPC architecture review / deep-dive

Marissa / Lauren 

Agenda I'm planning to run in the architecture review (60m):
- 5m: Intros and goals
- 15m: Current infra & high-level network topology (Acme)
- 20m: Proposed Redwood Private deployment options and network flows (VPC connector vs on-prem)
- 10m: Security/KMS discussion (handoff to security lead)
- 5m: Pilot checklist & next steps
- 5m: Q&A and actions

Pre-call asks (so we can prepare):
- Network diagram (vlan/subnet layout) and available NAT/egress options
- Any MFA/VPN requirements and whether you use a hardware HSM or cloud KMS
- Expected concurrency profile and token size for inference (we'll use this to pick initial node configs)

I'll prepare a short slide with the specific IP ranges and ports we typically need to be whitelisted for the pilot. Will confirm availability and send the calendar invite once Marissa confirms the final slot.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeindustrial.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Next steps: Private VPC architecture review / deep-dive

Marissa / Dev 

Tue 9 Jun, 9:00-10:00am PDT works for us. Please send the invite and any prep checklist. Michael (cc) will join from security.

Quick ask for the invite: can you include a short bullet list of the firewall/IP ranges we should open for the pilot? We prefer to add ranges to an allowlist rather than open broad ports. Also we'll populate the network-diagram-template.pdf and share before the call.

Thanks,
Alex
